name: seated frog half to full sit up
description: Sit-up started from a seated frog position, with knees out and soles together, to work the abs and open the hips.
instructions: Sit on the floor with the soles of your feet together and knees dropped out.
Lower your back halfway to the floor under control.
Pause, then lower fully to lie flat.
Curl your torso back up to sitting, using your abs.
Keep your feet together and avoid yanking on your neck.
